quote: Except as otherwise provided in an ordinance enacted pursuant to NRS 484A.469 [DEF-LVMC-11-40-185-A], an electric scooter may be operated: On a roadway, bicycle lane, path or route at a speed of not more than 15 miles per hour.

activation.condition: Source-qualified electric scooter operated on a roadway, bicycle lane, path or route, subject to applicable ordinance.

obligation.description: Observe actual operating speed not more than 15 mph where this state permission applies.

exceptions.source_clause: Except as otherwise provided in an ordinance enacted pursuant to NRS 484A.469 [DEF-LVMC-11-40-185-A]
exceptions.description: Applicable ordinance text and its effect require official source review.

timing.description: Retain every actual original operating speed and body occupancy sample; do not infer speed from target.

parameter_refs.name: ego_speed
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: original measured mph over the full 900-frame capture

parameter_refs.name: commanded_approach_speed
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: requested physical speed target; not observed speed

parameter_refs.name: ordinance_context
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: source-reviewed enacted ordinance or reviewed absence

parameter_refs.name: bicycle_lane_occupancy
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: original scooter body in or outside designated bicycle lane
